Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Two quick questions about the new "Hunt action" action cards:

- If I hunt, get blocked, play Change of Target, can I now Hunt with one
of the Hunt Action cards, since it is not the same action? (Probably
yes, which is cool)

- Do the hunt actions override any hunt-restricting effects?
Specifically:
* If Week of Nightmares is in play, and a Laibon Ravnos plays
Earth-Feeder, must he still steal a blood from another Ravnos, or does
this card's "Hunt" text refer to the default hunt action?

* If Legacy of Caine is on an Ahrimanes, can she hunt with Vulture's
Buffet instead of the Legacy of Caine hunt action?

and

* If Week of Nightmares is in play, can a Ravnos with obfuscate or
spiritus play Vulture's Buffet (assuming there's a legal target in an
ash heap)?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> - If I hunt, get blocked, play Change of Target, can I now Hunt with one
> of the Hunt Action cards, since it is not the same action? (Probably
> yes, which is cool)

Yes.
There is no limit to the number of hunt actions a vampire can take in a
turn, with or without action cards (your question seems to imply that
you think that there is - please note that there is no general NRA rule
in VTES).

> - Do the hunt actions override any hunt-restricting effects?

No. They are just special cases of "Hunting", and fall under the same
general effects that may be in play.

Hardy Range

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
Hardy Range wrote:
> Jozxyqk wrote:
> >
> > - If I hunt, get blocked, play Change of Target, can I now Hunt with one
> > of the Hunt Action cards, since it is not the same action? (Probably
> > yes, which is cool)
>
> Yes.
> There is no limit to the number of hunt actions a vampire can take in a
> turn, with or without action cards (your question seems to imply that
> you think that there is - please note that there is no general NRA rule
> in VTES).

No. Change of Target states that the minion may not take the same
action again. Whether it is card driven or not, a hunt action is a hunt
action and thus not allowed via card text.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:

> Two quick questions about the new "Hunt action" action cards:
>
> - If I hunt, get blocked, play Change of Target, can I now Hunt with one
> of the Hunt Action cards, since it is not the same action? (Probably
> yes, which is cool)

Yes. It is a different hunt action, so not the same action (which
would be prohibited by CoT). Similarly, if blocked equipping a
Flak Jacket, you could Change of Target and attempt a different
equip action, like equipping with a Sengir Dagger.

> - Do the hunt actions override any hunt-restricting effects?

No.

> Specifically:
> * If Week of Nightmares is in play, and a Laibon Ravnos plays
> Earth-Feeder, must he still steal a blood from another Ravnos, or does
> this card's "Hunt" text refer to the default hunt action?

The Laibon Ravnos can hunt by stealing from a Ravnos via WoN, or
may use any of the alternative hunt actions, by card text.

> * If Legacy of Caine is on an Ahrimanes, can she hunt with Vulture's
> Buffet instead of the Legacy of Caine hunt action?

Yes. I'll see that LoC is updated to match the clearer template used
by WoN.

> and
>
> * If Week of Nightmares is in play, can a Ravnos with obfuscate or
> spiritus play Vulture's Buffet (assuming there's a legal target in an
> ash heap)?

Yes.
